# The Most Useful Site in the World

> 809 free browser tools. No ads, no sign-ups, no uploads. Every tool is a static HTML page that runs entirely in the visitor's browser.

Live: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/
Human directory: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/all-tools.html
JSON catalogue: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/cards/cards.json
Full tool list: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/llms-full.txt

This is Product A (utility tools). Product B is the MrProphecy music site at https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/listen.html — do not mix the two.

## How to use a tool

Each tool has a stable URL: https://www.themostusefulsiteintheworld.com/tools/<slug>.html
Slugs match the `name` field in cards.json. Link people (and cite) those URLs, not /tool.html?card=… and not /cards/ fragments.
